commentary.text: 90+7' That's all for today as the game is over.
90+6' Dani Raba (Leganes) is first to the rebound inside the box but sends his effort high over the bar.
90+5' Leganes fail to threaten from the corner kick as the opposition's goalkeeper plucks the ball out of the air.
90+4' Duk (Leganes) produces a poor pass. He attempts to get the ball into the box but it's hacked away.
90+3' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Oscar Mingueza (Celta Vigo) was quite harsh and Isidro Diaz didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
90' There will be a minimum of 5 min. of added time.
90' We are about to witness a subsitution. Julian Chicco (Leganes) for Renato Tapia.
89' Celebrations are cut short for Celta Vigo as the referee indicates NO GOAL after the VAR review shows it was offside!
89' Celebrations by Celta Vigo are cut short as the referee signals that the legality of the goal will be checked using the VAR. Hopefully this won’t take too long.
88' Pablo Duran (Celta Vigo) receives a well-taken defence-splitting low pass inside the box and scores! His great effort makes its way into the bottom right corner of the net.
85' Leganes seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. Great movement by the offensive players allows the defenders to set up the attack.
83' Here is a change. Sergio Gonzalez Poirrier is going off and Borja Jimenez gives the last tactical orders to Duk (Leganes).
83' Substitution. Borja Iglesias leaves the pitch and is replaced by Pablo Duran (Celta Vigo).
82' Marcos Alonso (Celta Vigo) fails to find any of his teammates inside the box as his pass is blocked.
81' The corner from Oscar Mingueza (Celta Vigo) is hurriedly cleared.

81' Iker Losada (Celta Vigo) produces an inaccurate low pass into the box that is blocked by the one of the defenders. If this pass had slipped through, the ball would have probably ended up in the back of the net.
78' Marko Dmitrovic comes off his line to intercept the corner from Fran Beltran (Celta Vigo).

78' Alfonso Gonzalez (Celta Vigo) latches on to a precise defence-splitting pass and fires a nice strike from a promising distance towards the right post. Marko Dmitrovic has a clear sight of it and makes a comfortable save. Celta Vigo force a corner. Their opponents will face another attacking threat.
76' Isidro Diaz shows a yellow card to Jorge Saenz de Miera Colmeiro (Leganes) for his blatant foul.
75' Claudio Giraldez has decided to substitute Jailson and he is replaced by Ilaix Moriba (Celta Vigo).
75' The referee signals a substitution. Javier Rodriguez (Celta Vigo) is brought on as a substitute for Hugo Sotelo.
75' Juan Cruz (Leganes) is flagged for offside.

72' A short pass finds Miguel de la Fuente (Leganes) in acres of space on the edge of the box and he decides to go for glory. His efforts looks in for all the world but just creeps past the left post.
71' Dani Raba (Leganes) goes over to take the corner kick and it looks like he will send the ball into the penalty box.
71' Oscar Rodriguez (Leganes) fails to deliver a decent cross from a long-range free kick. The opposition's defence intercepts the effort.
70' Jailson (Celta Vigo) is awarded a yellow card. The referee showed him no mercy.
69' We can have a look at the statistics now, shots on target are 3:5.
67' Substitution. Miguel de la Fuente (Leganes) has come on for Diego Garcia.
67' Borja Jimenez has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Dani Raba (Leganes) replacing Seydouba Cisse.
59' Claudio Giraldez has decided to make a change. Iker Losada (Celta Vigo) replaces Iago Aspas.
59' Here's the change. Damian Rodriguez leaves the pitch and Fran Beltran (Celta Vigo) comes on as a substitute.
57' Sergio Carreira (Celta Vigo) attempts to send a low pass into the box from the edge of the penalty area, but the opposition's defence knocks the ball to safety.
56' Damian Rodriguez (Celta Vigo) has tested the patience of referee Isidro Diaz and goes into the book for a previous late challenge.

55' Leganes slow the tempo of the game down by exchanging a combination of one or two touch passes. The opposition's players are finding it very difficult at the moment, very physically demanding to run without the ball.
49' Diego Garcia (Leganes) jumps inside the box to meet the resulting set piece and aims a header towards the middle of the goal, but the goalkeeper shows his reflexes and makes a superb save.
48' Leganes force a corner. They send men into the box.
46' A substitution has been made. Matija Nastasic goes off and Jorge Saenz de Miera Colmeiro (Leganes) comes on.
46' Referee Isidro Diaz blows his whistle to start the second half.
45+5' That is it for the first half after the referee blows his whistle and the players head to their respective dressing rooms.
45+1' 2 - 1 Goal! Alfonso Gonzalez (Celta Vigo) finds himself some space inside the box to get on the end of a pass from Borja Iglesias, then sends the ball into the bottom right corner. 2:1.
45' The fourth official shows 3 min. of added time.
44' Iago Aspas (Celta Vigo) tries to send a pass but it's blocked.
39' Referee Isidro Diaz waves Matija Nastasic (Leganes) back on as his red card is expunged after a VAR review!
39' The Celta Vigo players’ joy was short-lived as the original decision is reversed after a VAR review by referee Isidro Diaz. NO PENALTY!
38' The referee isn't 100% sure if it's a penalty to Celta Vigo, he's going to review using VAR.
37' Matija Nastasic (Leganes) does not realise that he has already received a yellow card and is shocked when the referee shows him a second one!
37' Isidro Diaz blows his whistle and signals a foul after Matija Nastasic (Leganes) brought his opponent down. Celta Vigo are awarded a penalty kick!
33' Juan Cruz (Leganes) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge.
32' Renato Tapia (Leganes) attempts to head the rebound into the roof of the net, but Vicente Guaita reads his intention and makes an incredible reflex save!
32' Oscar Rodriguez (Leganes) goes over to take the corner kick and it looks like he will swing the ball into the penalty box.

31' Diego Garcia (Leganes) receives a low pass just outside the box and unleashes a fine strike towards the right post. Vicente Guaita pulls off a reflexive save to block his effort. Nice goalkeeping skill, indeed. It will be a corner kick for Leganes.
30' Valentin Rosier (Leganes) delivers a fine lofted cross into the penalty area, but it's cleared by an opposing player.
29' A short pass finds Oscar Rodriguez (Leganes). He spots the keeper off his line and shoots from mid-range, but the ball sails high over the bar.
26' 1 - 1 Oscar Mingueza (Celta Vigo) latches on to a precise pass inside the box and sends in a superb strike that finds its way into the bottom right corner.
25' The game is interrupted as Valentin Rosier (Leganes) is flagged offside.
24' Another attempt to send the ball beyond the defence by Diego Garcia (Leganes) is thwarted and cleared to safety.
23' Oscar Rodriguez (Leganes) attempts to slip the ball through the defence, but is unable to find any of his teammates.
22' Alfonso Gonzalez (Celta Vigo) sends a pass into the box, but his attempt is thwarted and cleared.

19' 0 - 1 Goal! Juan Cruz displays great vision and sends a pass to Valentin Rosier (Leganes), who shows brilliant composure inside the box to bury the ball into the bottom left corner. The score is 0:1.
16' Wonderful movement by Leganes. The players are holding possession, mostly exchanging one-touch passes. They control the pace of the game now.
15' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Leganes.
14' Oscar Rodriguez (Leganes) slides a pass forward, but one of the defenders cuts it out.
11' Borja Iglesias (Celta Vigo) latches on to a pin-point through ball, but one of the defending players dispossess him. Brilliant defending.
9' Matija Nastasic (Leganes) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Isidro Diaz had an easy-decision to make.
9' Valentin Rosier (Leganes) is offside and the linesman raises his flag.
8' Alfonso Gonzalez (Celta Vigo) goes on a weaving run through the defence and gets within shooting range but his effort is blocked.
3' Celta Vigo are showing great team chemistry. They are passing it around beautifully. Excellent team work.
1' The referee blows his whistle and we are underway.
Celta Vigo will kick the game off.
Isidro Diaz is the one to supervise the game today.
